about_the_game:
ODYSSEY RPG

Step into the sandals of a wandering hero in Odyssey RPG, a classic-style JRPG that brings the epic of Homer to life like never before!

🌍 Explore a Mythical World
From the burning shores of Troy to the eerie songs of the Sirens, each destination is steeped in danger, mystery, and legend. Sail across the seas, battle ancient beasts, and test your resolve against the gods themselves.

🗺️ Your Journey Awaits

  • Defeat the Trojans

  • Survive the brutal ambushes of the Cicones

  • Escape the dreamlike fog of the Land of the Lotus Eaters

  • Outsmart the monstrous Cyclops on his cursed island

  • Brave the dark secrets of the Underworld

  • Endure the bewitching charms of Circe and Calypso

  • Face down the fury of Scylla and the whirlpool Charybdis

  • Return home through storm, betrayal, and divine wrath to reach Ithaca

⚔️ Turn-Based Combat – Classic JRPG battles with strategic depth. Customize your party with mythic gear, ancient magic, and heroic skills.

🏛️ Made with Passion in RPG Maker – Indie-crafted with love, pixel art, and countless drachma of dedication.

🛡️ Odyssey RPG is more than a game – it's a journey home. Will you find your way back, or be lost to myth forever?

⚓ Begin your voyage today. The gods are watching.

Recommended route and levels:

  • Troy - LVL 1

  • Cicones - LVL 5

  • Land of Lotus Eaters - LVL 10

  • Cyclops Island - LVL 15

  • Aeolus Island - LVL 20

  • Island of the Laestrygonian Cannibals - LVL 25

  • Circe's Island (Aeaea) - LVL 30

  • Underworld (region) - LVL 35

  • Island of Helios - LVL 40

  • Calypso's Island (Ogygia) - LVL 45

  • Sirens, Scylla & Charybdis (region) - LVL 50

  • Land of the Phaecians (Scheria) & Ithaca  - LVL 55
